description: Read live account details from the upstream PDS: handle, email, confirmation state, invitation status and takedown flag. Requires a service JWT (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) and account.admin. The response is trimmed to the fields the console displays; upstream-only data such as threat signatures is never returned.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The account does not exist on the upstream PDS.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The PDS administrator credential is not configured.

errors.name: UpstreamAuthFailed
errors.description: The PDS rejected the administrator credential.

errors.name: UpstreamUnavailable
errors.description: The PDS is unreachable or timed out.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The PDS rate limited the request.
